title: Stunning rooftop
text:
Some stunning architecture, well worth a visit.
The rooftop blew my breath away, loved it.
It was incredibly hot whilst we were there though, plenty of water needed!
author: Ruth_D

title: Just wow!!
text:
This place blew me away it was my first time going to Spain/aboard for the first time and I had no idea what to expect but this place will not disappoint at all!! It’s the most beautiful place ever no matter how little or lots you know about gaudi and his artwork the whole entire place left me in awe especially the last room with all the lights I wanted to stay there forever 
The guide is very helpful and they ask what language you are then give it to you I believe there’s 15 different languages these include

title: PERFECT
text:
Perfect!
No wait at the entrance and an interesting audio-guided tour 
Be careful on the rooftop terrace; there are many different levels, and the steps are not very well marked... you look up and to the sides, not really where you place your feet...

title: Great Experience at Casa Mila
text: Loved the smooth entry and the audio guide was really informative. The rooftop views and architecture were incredible. Totally worth a visit!

title: Unique Architecture and Easy Entry
text: Casa Mila is stunning! The reserved entry saved time, and the audio guide made the visit more meaningful. Gaudí’s design is truly one of a kind.

text:

title: Avoid booking with: Yo Tours Yravel
text: Casa Mila was beautiful & very interesting. BEWARE TRIP ADVISOR VENDERS, Yo Tours Yravel. They canceled our tour, said they rebooked, then did not complete. We were left without support, support staff completely unhelpful & we were left to scramble & quite upset. I will never book thru trip advisor again!! Advise you to beware.
author: 8137Pidgeon
